data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's contradiction claim is internally self-refuting on the arithmetic it asserts. It states SRC_002 computes the exactly-two-same complement as 9 × 2 × 9 = 162, then claims the agreement at 648 'depends on compensating errors' and that 162 is only correct if all-same is treated as 9. But SRC_002's own refutation-if clause requires showing the 9 × 2 × 9 quantity 'already accounts for all 252 tuples including the AAA triple' — which directly contradicts SRC_002's earlier assertion that 162 is the exactly-two-same complement. A single quantity cannot simultaneously be (a) the exactly-two-same complement equal to 162 and (b) a 252-tuple accounting that includes AAA. The target thus presents a contradiction relation whose endpoints are not even consistent within the target's own text.
